none: PAS CAM-07D6F3: Roman Coin: Incomplete copper-alloy nummus of Gratian, AD 367-383
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A slightly incomplete copper-alloy nummus of Gratian, AD 367-383 (Reece period 19). Mint is Arles, AD 367-375. Reverse legend reads [GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI]. Reverse shows Emperor standing, holding standard and shield. See RIC IX, no.15 and LRBC c.f.503 passim. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Condition is fine, die axis…
